pr91Comparison.scope: Same code, different CI host and sample; no causal improvement/regression or sustained-capacity inference.

protocol.scope: Real frontend editor with deterministic browser-routed mock API and synthetic authentication; no real backend, native executor or provider.
protocol.budgetScope: Actions, autosave and heap sampling; observer disposal/reporting use the remaining 90-second test ceiling.
protocol.actionWallTiming: Includes automation, assertions and the mock autosave debounce; not a processing/paint latency.
protocol.clocks: Actions use Node monotonic time; heap/EventTiming use browser monotonic time from probe installation. These nearby origins are not identical.

fieldINP.reason: A finite automated laboratory interaction sample is not field INP.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.8010.12 Safari/537.36

protocol.cache: warm context reused after existing learning visits; no cache clearing

inp.reason: Three finite scripted page visits do not establish page-lifetime or field INP. Event Timing samples are retained separately.

method: Nearest rank uses sorted[ceil(n*p)-1]; n5/n8/n10 p95 and p99 equal sample maxima. Browser switch and LCP/CLS use arithmetic median. Raw vectors remain separate per run and protocol.
limitations: Actual source/probe equality does not control host contention, hardware, warmup or sample variability; no causal performance comparison.
CPU endpoint counters are lifetime cumulative; RSS excludes native/compiler/Postgres/Redis and is not an aggregate simultaneous peak.
Plan WAL and cluster WAL use different boundaries; original LSN endpoints and restore dump bytes are not retained.
Event Timing is a thresholded truncated prefix, not full-session INP; coarse heap values do not establish leak absence.
Run/job status and QA/Security semantic acceptance are separate; no acceptance is inferred solely from numerical consistency.
